items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Earl Amadee, myself, and the late, uh, uh, George, uh, uh, oh, he just died here recently. Boy, I'm just trying to think. Uh, Augustine. We were the first, we put together, uh, uh, uh, I think one of the first integrated political organizations

ctx.x: Well, what were they going to charge you with? I mean, what could they have?

Well, I don't know what he was charging me, but they, but a certain, certain whites and I got, got it in black and white. I got letters and I have cards that were sent to me by the white citizen council. And, uh, incidentally, uh, prior to that, I was a registered Republican incidentally, and I was on a Republican committee, uh, when, uh, when, uh, um, Eisenhower was running for office. And I sold somewhere around about, uh, a few hundred dollars worth of tickets. They wouldn't even let me go into the front door…
Well, was there a name for the organization?
